rungs.foldTest: 'Microsoft Office 2016 was involved in an event' -> 'Microsoft Office was involved in an event': same claim stated less precisely with release year qualifier removed

rejected.reason: Vulnerability identifier, not an entity in the Software category.
Data document/spreadsheet file, not a software program or application.
Software suite part-whole aggregation introduces a subject change (preserving: false) while version qualifier stripping already captures the sound identity-preserving product projection.

ladder.notes: Surface forms contain versioned releases (e.g., Office 2016), unversioned base products/suites (MS Office), standalone malware names (Petya, Misha), and suite components (MS Word, MS Excel, Microsoft Equation Editor). The version-to-product projection (drop-qualifier) is the cleanest identity-preserving ladder step.
